name: impact
description: Given a changed file (explicit path, git diff, or staged changes), compute the reverse-dependency closure plus matching test files in a TypeScript/JavaScript monorepo using madge or dependency-cruiser (auto-installed if missing), and codegraph for test-file detection when the repo has an index. Returns a structured report of what a change probably affects, grouped by package, so Claude can skip Explore-subagent calls when asking 'what does this break' or 'what tests should I run'.
